entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker who proposes baiting the Phyrexians with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself, and works at the Mana Rig with Jhoira.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An ancient archmage planeswalker who goes to Yavimaya to recruit the elves and fights a dragon engine alongside Meria.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A fire-wielding planeswalker who joins Danitha's attack on a Phyrexian cave.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who tracked the kidnappers to a cave and fights with Danitha's forces.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A recovering planeswalker who recruits Shivan allies, including the dragon Darigaaz.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Karn's friend, who reconciles with him and plans a self-destruct mechanism for the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Raff
entities.description: A mage who heals Teferi and says his sister will fight for Karn.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: Daughter of Aron Capashen and heir of House Capashen, who hunts her father's kidnappers.

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: The leader of House Capashen, compleated by the Phyrexians and beheaded by Danitha.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A reanimated, compleated former member of the Weatherlight's crew who now serves Sheoldred and leads the Phyrexians in the cave.

entities.name: Meria
entities.description: A young Yavimaya elf leader who rejects Jodah's request until a dragon engine attacks, then uses a Thran artifact to defeat it.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: The Phyrexian aide to Sheoldred who drives a dragon engine against Yavimaya.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: A dragon of Shiv who destroys a Phyrexian monster and agrees to fight for the New Coalition.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: The Keldon warlord who arrives on the Golden Argosy and kills the Phyrexian dreadnought.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor whom Ertai and Rona serve.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A vampire member of the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: A fungal creature of the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: A winged member of the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A Yavimaya spirit who will sort the good from the bad among the elves.

entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: A New Argive noble who turned out to be a sleeper agent.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who hold a cave base, a dreadnought and a dragon engine.

entities.name: New Coalition
entities.description: The alliance forming at Shiv to fight the Phyrexians.

entities.name: House Capashen
entities.description: The Benalish noble house whose knights fight in Danitha's army.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: The warriors of Keld who arrive with Radha.

entities.name: Llanowar elves
entities.description: Archers from Llanowar who join Ajani.

entities.name: Yavimaya elves
entities.description: Elves of Yavimaya led by Meria who eventually join the coalition.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: An airship that carries the planeswalkers and is attacked over Shiv.

entities.name: Golden Argosy
entities.description: An ancient golden ship that Radha rediscovered and uses to attack the dreadnought.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A Thran device that the Phyrexians want, used by Karn as bait.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: Jhoira's city-sized structure in Shiv, used as the coalition's base.

entities.name: Phyrexian dreadnought
entities.description: A huge Phyrexian monstrosity that breaks out of a mountain and is killed by the Keldons.

entities.name: Dragon engine
entities.description: A huge Phyrexian-driven machine that attacks Yavimaya and is disabled by a Thran vacuum device.

entities.name: Thran vacuum globe
entities.description: A silver globe with golden tracery that creates a spherical vacuum, killing the dragon engine's organic parts.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A jungle region where Jodah meets Meria in the ruins of Kroog.

entities.name: Red Iron Mountains
entities.description: The mountains where Danitha has camped and where the Phyrexian cave lies.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The volcanic region home to the Mana Rig and allied dragons.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane under Phyrexian invasion.

events.summary: On the Weatherlight, Karn proposes forcing the Phyrexians into open war by baiting them with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself; the group splits up to recruit allies.
events.quote: "We must force the Phyrexians into open warfare," Karn said

events.summary: Jaya meets Ajani and Danitha Capashen, who is searching for her kidnapped father, and joins them to attack the Phyrexian cave.
events.quote: "Well, one sure way to get someone out of a cave is smoke."

events.summary: Jodah meets Meria in Yavimaya, who declines to commit her troops to Shiv.
events.quote: But travel to Shiv? No, I think not.

events.summary: Jaya, Ajani and Danitha's forces attack the cave, burning the guards, but are overwhelmed when more Phyrexians pour out.
Ertai emerges from the cave with Aron Capashen, now compleated.
events.quote: And Aron Capashen stepped from the cave's mouth.

events.summary: Darigaaz destroys a Phyrexian monster attacking the Weatherlight over Shiv and accepts Teferi's proposal to fight.
events.quote: "I accept your proposal to fight here at Shiv.

events.summary: Ertai orders Aron to attack Danitha, and Danitha beheads her father.
events.quote: separating his head from his shoulders.

events.summary: Ertai summons a Phyrexian dreadnought from the mountain.
events.quote: A Phyrexian monstrosity broke free from the mountain in front of them

events.summary: A Phyrexian dragon engine driven by Rona attacks Yavimaya, uprooting the Magnigoths.
events.quote: a dragon engine reared into Yavimaya's vacant blue skies.

events.summary: Ertai threatens to have the dreadnought kill everyone unless Jaya and Ajani surrender, and Danitha stops the fight.
events.quote: "If you don't give yourselves up to me," Ertai said

events.summary: Meria finds a Thran artifact in the mud; Jodah portals them away and it creates a vacuum that kills the dragon engine's organic parts.
events.quote: The Thran weapon had created a spherical vacuum.

events.summary: Rona flees from the dragon engine, and Meria decides her people must fight.
events.quote: "Then there's only one path for us. And it doesn't lie in Yavimaya."

events.summary: The Golden Argosy arrives; Radha and her Keldon warriors board the dreadnought and kill it.
events.quote: Hundreds of Keldon warriors leapt from the ship

events.summary: Ertai threatens that Sheoldred will hear of this, and the dreadnought collapses.
events.quote: Ertai bellowed, "Sheoldred will hear of this!"

events.summary: Karn and Jhoira reconcile in her workshop and she plans a self-destruct mechanism for the Mana Rig.
events.quote: "Ah, I missed you." Jhoira laughed and embraced him.

events.summary: Jodah calls Karn to say Meria recruited neighboring groups and warns that there is a spy in the New Coalition.
events.quote: "There is a spy in the New Coalition."

relations.note: Danitha is Aron's daughter and heir.
relations.quote: Danitha Capashen, daughter of Aron Capashen, heir to the House Capashen.
She raised her broadsword and swept it down in a graceful arc, separating his head from his shoulders.

relations.note: Ertai says Sheoldred taught him beauty in change.
relations.quote: "Sheoldred has taught me that beauty lies in change,"

relations.note: Rona drives the dragon engine for the Phyrexians.
Ertai demands Jaya and Ajani surrender and threatens to kill them all.
relations.quote: "Jaya. Ajani. If you don't give yourselves up to me,"

relations.note: They work together to defeat the dragon engine.
The Keldons join the Benalish knights against the dreadnought.
relations.quote: Radha herself led her warriors onto the Phyrexian dreadnought's battering-ram head.
"I might be the captain, Karn, but you're setting the course.

relations.note: Jhoira's workshop and the Rig lie in Shiv.
relations.quote: In Shiv's skies—so hot they were not blue but a seared white
